title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省San Fernando绕行公路与San Fernando绕行延伸公路定级为国道并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Classifying the San Fernando Bypass Road and San Fernando Bypass Extension Road in the Province of La Union, Into National Roads and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Classifying the San Fernando Bypass Road and San Fernando Bypass Extension Road in the Province of La Union, Into National Roads and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11606_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The San Fernando Bypass Road and San Fernando Bypass Extension Road in the Province of La Union are hereby classified as national roads.

The San Fernando Bypass Road shall consist of the 4.455 kilometer road starting from Km. 266 + 578 to Km. 271 + 033, San Fernando Bypass Channel “A” starting from Km. 266 + 612 to Km. 266 + 647, and the San Fernando Bypass Channel “B” starting from Km. 279 + 407 + to Km. 270 + 468. Likewise, the San Fernando Bypass Road Extension shall consist of the 4.769 kilometer road starting from Km. 269 + 585 to Km. 274 + 354, the San Fernando Bypass Road Extension Channel “A” starting from Km. 269 + 880 to Km. 270 + 226, and the San Fernando Bypass Extension Channel “B” starting from Km. 274 + 301 to Km. 274 + 333.

The Secretary of Public Works and Highways shall include in the Department’s program the improvement, maintenance and repair of the said roads, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
